title: R. Abrahami Eleazaris Uraltes chymisches Werk, welches ehedessen von dem Autore theils in
creator: Abraham Eleazar
summary: German printed two-volume work (1760) under the name Abraham Eleazar. Vol. 1 is the ancient chemical work; vol. 2 is Donum Dei Samuelis Baruch, claiming a secret from Tubalcain. Plates of vessels and furnaces.

title: Atalanta fvgiens
creator: Maier, Michael, 1568?-1622.
summary: Michael Maier, Atalanta fugiens (1618): 50 copperplate emblems, each with motto, epigram, and a three-voice fugue. Signature emblem-book of European alchemy.

title: [Alchemy, in German]
summary: German manuscript, c. 1610. Only 8 images digitized. Geometric diagrams with lunar crests.

title: [Reading notes on alchemy]
creator: Newton, Isaac, Sir, 1642-1727
summary: Isaac Newton's reading notes, c. 1700, on mining and preparation of lead. Working notes, not a finished treatise.

title: Tripus aureus
creator: Basilius Valentinus; Maier; Norton
summary: Maier's Golden Tripod (1618): Basil Valentine Twelve Keys, Norton's Ordinal, Cremer's Testament, with emblematic plates.

title: Alchemical miscellany
summary: Large c. 1550 miscellany in Latin, Italian, and Spanish: traditional alchemies mixed with practical procedures.

title: The ordinal of alchemy
creator: Norton, Thomas, active 1477
summary: c. 1610 copy of Thomas Norton of Bristol's Ordinal of Alchemy. Core English alchemical poem.

title: Alchemical miscellany
summary: c. 1760 paper manuscript known as Le veau d'or (The Golden Calf). Unidentified French alchemy.

title: Alchemical miscellany
creator: Avicenna; Jabir; Razi; Richard de Fournival
summary: c. 1350 practical Latin miscellany. One of the oldest Mellon alchemy volumes.

title: The compound of alchymy
creator: Ripley, George
summary: George Ripley, Compound of Alchemy, 1591. Twelve gates toward the stone and potable gold. Imperfect copy.
